title: Hand Performance and Strength Evaluation in Smartphone users in the Healthy Population: A Study Protocol
protocol: Explain the procedure thoroughly to all participants.
Collect data using Google form of SAS-SV questionnaire.
Evaluate smartphone addiction using qDASH questionnaire.
Assess upper extremity functional independency using qDASH questionnaire.
Perform statistical analysis on collected data.
Draw results based on statistical analysis.
Analyze and draw conclusions from the results.
